title: Vault path precedence: manifest > explicit env override (enabled only) > deprecated legacy ONTOLOGY_PAGES_DIR (cleared when disabled)
scope: the ACTUAL _ab_vault_resolve extracted from config/entrypoint-unified.sh with a stub _ab_toml_val, plus each consumer run as a child process against throwaway fixture corpora; no real manifest, vault or corpus read or written
precedence: 2 explicit environment override — honoured only while AGENTBOX_VAULT_ENABLED=1, or with AGENTBOX_VAULT_LEGACY_PATHS=1
3 legacy ONTOLOGY_PAGES_DIR — cleared + warned when the vault is disabled and there is no opt-in

implementation.incidental_fix: scripts/ontology-condense-refresh.sh: `exec 9>"$LOCK" 2>/dev/null` had permanently re-pointed the whole script stderr at /dev/null, swallowing every diagnostic; stderr is now saved on fd 8 and restored after the lock attempt.
